budget_items.topic: Police Officers Union contract (Memorandum of Agreement)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Selectmen signed a 3-year agreement with annual increases of 2.5%, 2%, and 2%, with an additional cost over the previous cost of $139,000 over the contract term.
budget_items.quote: additional cost to fund the contract over previous cost will be $139,000 over the 3-year term of the contract.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New growth was certified for $88,222; the Town Manager recommends appropriating those funds to the Special Purpose Stabilization Fund via Article 2 of the Special Town Meeting warrant.
budget_items.quote: new growth was certified today for $88,222. town manager recommends to follow-through with provisions of article 2 on the special town meeting warrant
